about_the_game: Uncover the origins of Bubble Ghost Remake in this exclusive prequel comic. Told through the eyes of Sofia—Heinrich’s beloved—you’ll dive deeper into the world and characters you’ll meet during your adventure. This 36-page digital book, beautifully illustrated in watercolor by the game’s own artists, also includes a special artbook section featuring concept art, sketches, and visual resources. A must-have for fans of the game and lovers of digital art alike. Don’t miss this chance to explore the emotional and artistic heart of the Bubble Ghost Remake universe!
